answer: A resumed TLS session presents a PSK ticket bound to the original handshake, proving the same client returned. A farm needs 345 distinct tickets, since one ticket cannot resume 345 sessions. The ticket is checked on every resumption, and the binding must match the enrolled session. The hollow check runs in the open: 345 fakes pay the full price 345 times, one honest agent pays once, and the lotus trail in the ledger makes the pigment cost visible to everyone.
